modelfix:
Model Gap FIX

 

This is a simple client mod that fixes https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-73186

which affects both Block Models and Item Models and possibly other models too

 

The mod works by removing texture zooming, making every model face use 100% of its texture, unlike of what it did previoulsly.

Thisnot only fixes this bugs on items (where it's most noticeable) but with block models too and everything else that might use those functions.

 

This issue was especially noticeable with custom block models or some 2d items.

 

 

Q&A:

- Will this slow down my game? 

Not at all! Removing texture zooming just removes some code and has no impact. If you however want to be nit picky the mod also slightly tweaks item models in a way that could add a ouple more quads for concave item textures compared to vanilla so in that case it could very slightly worse that vanilla. Paxi is a simple mod for global, automatic data and resource packs. 
 Usually, data packs have to be loaded separately for every world. Paxi adds the paxi folder in your Minecraft config folder, where you can place data and resource packs that will automatically be loaded for every world. The first time you run Paxi, the paxi  folder will be created for you in your Minecraft config directory. 

 Paxi is as simple as it gets when it comes to global data and resource packs, making it a great utility for modpack creators! 

 
 
Within the paxi folder is a datapacks folder for data packs. This folder will be created for you the first time you create or load a world with Paxi installed. Any data packs placed in this folder will be automatically loaded into any world you play - in other words, globally loaded data packs! When in game, use the command /datap

hardcore-revival:
Have you ever played Hardcore multiplayer with friends and suddenly your teammate died to a dumb mistake while you were just being comfy at home? You usually would be forced to restart, even though you didn't really do anything wrong. Maybe your friend didn't do anything wrong either. Overall I believe that death in hardcore is only fun if it feels like you really deserved it, for example while fighting a strong boss monster.

Therefore, this mod aims to solve this problem! When a player dies, instead of being gone for good, they enter a K.O. state, at which point a timer will start running. Being the good friend you are, you can attempt to save them in time. If you do, everything is fine - they get a small debuff and a strong appetite and you two can be on your way again. If you don't, for example because you died while trying to save them, or you just didn't ~~care about your friend~~

notenoughrecipebook:
This mod was created for only one simple purpose - completely remove recipe book from the game. However, unlike other similar mods, this one does not just hide the recipe book button. NERB completely removes its functionality.

 

If you have a fully unlocked recipe book in a large modpack and run the command /data get entity @s, you will see how horrible the amount of data it gives (most of them are recipe names). However, after installing this mod, these recipe names will disappear, which greatly improves the performance of CraftTweaker / KubeJS (e.g. using event.player.data in event scripts) or other mods to read player data, and speeds up data sync between the server and the client & makes player join world faster.

This mod should be installed both on client- and server-side!

CIT Resewn has two issues in large modpacks. First, it re-evaluates custom item textures every frame even when nothing has changed — this causes unnecessary CPU usage when browsing large inventories or EMI item grids. Second, it leaks over 1 GB of RAM per session by allocating objects into every ItemStack that are never freed.  

This is a patch for https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn

 What does HTP CITOptimizer do? 

Caches CIT evaluation results so repeat lookups are skipped, and fixes a massive memory leak.
Significantly reduced GC pressure from eliminated per-frame allocations. 
Lower CPU usage when browsing large inventories or EMI item grids.  

Your client will no longer freeze, crash, or lag after hours of gameplay requiring a restart due to CITResewn.

 Forge / NeoForge / Fabric , making it easier to build fully featured graphical user interfaces.

Roughly Enough IDs is a lightweight mod that removes the block, item, biome, potion, and enchantment ID limits by using the 1.13 chunk format in 1.12.

More specifically, it uses a blockstate palette when saving chunks to NBT, and uses an int biome array rather than a byte biome array. There should be very few incompatibilities with other mods, but in case you find one, please report it to the issue tracker.

Unlike NotEnoughIDs, removing a mod from your modpack is supported, and won‘t cause corruption of the worlds created with that mod.

 Extremely important : Removing Roughly Enough IDs will break your world!

AdvancementsScreen Optimizer

 ⚠️ Mojang fixed this issue in 1.21.2+, so this mod is no longer required ⚠️

Optimizes how the advancements screen is rendered

Some mods that modify the advancements screen might be incompatible!

 How it works

Minecraft has to render a lot of textures when drawing the advancements screen. These include
 - the background
 - the icons
 - the lines

For each one it draws all the textures individually, requiring communication with the GPU each time.

The mod improves performance by batching most draw calls, so only a single one is made.
Furthermore, it avoids drawing textures which are outside the advancements screen.

angel-islands:
Angel Islands
 

This worldgen datapack adds floating islands above the world's oceans whilst also retaining regular land generation! 

By default, islands are fairly frequent yet scattered over the oceans. They are found only in the deepest section of oceans, typically around mushroom islands.

You could consider this pack a mix between regular worldgen and my other datapack, Aetherial Islands.

 Notice:
The default foliage (trees, grass, flowers, etc.) typically would spawn on the highest surface block. I have modified them so that they can spawn on any level, so if an island is above an island, its shadow doesn't block trees from spawning on it. This also results in slightly different tree placement in the rest of the overworld.

 Also checkout
- Skylands over the Sea a mod that replaces the void in Aetherial Islands with an infinite ocean.
- Aetherial Islands: Clusters Edit an add-on

 How It Works 
 Before 26.3: 
 
 In singleplayer, the mod reads recipes from the integrated server directly.

 If a server already provides a recipe map, the mod stays out of the way. 
 

 After 26.3:

Don't Burn My Stuff is a Minecraft mod for the fabric mod loader. It aims to make the Fire Protection enchantment a bit more useful.
Features
 
It essentially does two things:
1. Makes every item enchantable with Fire Protection (Every means every. So also shears, saplings or dirt)
2. Items that are enchanted with Fire Protection don't burn in fire or lava anymore (like netherite)
 
Note: The level of the Fire Protection enchantment is irrelevant, even Fire Protection I protects stuff from high heat sources like lava. Fire Protection is still mutually exclusive to other Protection enchantments. So choose wisely.

This is a Fabric server-side mod that implements various countermeasures against mob farms.

 

 Natural Spawner Nerf 

This applies to "naturally spawned" mobs (that is, not through a mob spawner or structure generation), including the ones that continuously spawn in structures like Guardians. It detects when mobs originating from certain chunks die too frequently and slows down their spawn rates.

The algorithm can be configured through the nomobfarm.properties file:

 natural slowdown rate=1000    Rate at which mob spawns are slowed down relative to the
 mob death frequency. Higher values lead to longer intervals in which
                           mobs won't spawn.
 natural recovery rate=3.0E-4  Rate at which the spawn algorithm goes back to normal
                           when mobs aren't dying.. It's essentially the rate at which the algorithm
 "forgets" how many mobs died.

lamb-lanterns:
Lamb Lanterns is a small companion mod for LambDynamicLights. It lets you slot a vanilla lantern (or soul lantern) into a dedicated Lantern Curios slot — and then it actually behaves like one.

 What it does

- Adds a dedicated lantern slot to the Curios screen with a faded lantern silhouette icon. No fighting the belt slot for space with backpacks, rings, or charms.
- Renders the worn lantern hanging from the player's right hip, with a chain attachment on the actual hip-bone of the body model.

Rebrand

Rebrand is a light-weight mod for Fabric that allows you to hide and customize your client brand.

Whenever you connect to a multiplayer server, your client sends a message to the server containing a "brand". This brand would normally contain "vanilla", but Fabric and other mod loaders often fill it with information about the mod loader itself. Some servers use this to identify modded clients, and this can increase the risk of your account being banned from the server. Rebrand fixes this by hiding the mod loader information, and allowing you to set it either to the vanilla default, or a custom brand.

 Installation

Download the latest release of Rebrand for your client version, and drag it into your ./minecraft/mods folder.

 Optional Dependencies

Rebrand has support for Mod Menu, and can be configured via the mod list when this mod is installed.

 Locking
Shift right-click on a block with a trial key to lock it.

Locked blocks can't be interacted with or broken.

 Unlocking
Right-click with the correct key to unlock a block.

 Key Cloning
Use a Bolt Armor Trim , a Trial Key , and a Copper Ingot to clone a key in a smithing table.

The cloned key will work anywhere the original key does.

 Lost Keys

This mod is very simple: it adds gravel versions of vanilla and various modded ores that spawn in your world, as a means of gathering such resources without long mining trips. Ores will only register themselves or generate if they exist in other mods -- for example, Tin Gravel Ore will only spawn if you have another mod that adds tin.

As of 1.20.1, this mod is written entirely using JSON! It depends on Json Things for registering the ore blocks, and vanilla data packs for all other features.

The mod is also quite configurable. In 1.12 and earlier, you can use the config file to change ore pile size, ore pile frequency, blacklist certain ores from generating, and modify the generation weights of different ores. In 1.20.1+, you can configure the ores directly using datapacks!

If you have any other questions, ask them in our discord.

bow-spam-be-gone:
Bow Spam Be-Gone!

 
 

 

 
 

This project prevents bow-spam by forcing players to fully charge their bows in-order to shoot an arrow. It's a pretty small and simple mod without any configuration.

 Usage

This mod is required on the server-side in order to work. The mod is purely optional on the client-side. 

- When added to the server, bow-spam is prevented as arrow spawning is blocked unless the bow is fully drawn back.
- When added to the client, an audible tick is played when the bow is fully charged, to make the charge more obvious.

 ☎️ Contact

- Discord: Support Server or @CG360
- GitHub: /squeeglii

securitycraft-wthit-addon:
SecurityCraft "WTHIT"-Addon
 
This is an addon mod for the Minecraft mod SecurityCraft, adding integration with WTHIT. While this is part of the main mod in newer Minecraft versions, technical limitations mean that this isn't the case in SecurityCraft for Minecraft 1.18.2 and 1.16.5. This addon mod fills that gap and adds WTHIT integration to SecurityCraft in those versions.\
This mod requires at least SecurityCraft v1.9.8. Supported versions are listed in the changelog of a file.
 
 Features
 
When installed, this mod will add more information to the WTHIT display for SecurityCraft's blocks, such as:
- Who the owner is
- What modules are installed
- What mode the block is in

Additionally, WTHIT will show disguised blocks and block mines as the block they are disguised as, instead of as themselves.\
There are a few config settings, making it possible to turn off certain info.

Off-Hand: Prevents the totem from blocking your peripheral view.

The "Pop" Animation: Shrinks the large on-screen animation that triggers

libhud:
libhud is a small library mod for fabric aiming to provide better compatibility between mods adding ingame hud components to the game.
 

If you're a
- player : This mod won't change anything gameplay-wise for you, other mods might depend on libhud though, requiring you to install it alongside them
 modpack creator : Even though libhud aims to improve compatibility, it will take some time for other mods to adopt and support libhud, thus there will inevitably be incompatibilities - please ask the creators of incompatible mods to implement support
- modder : libhud provides a simple api for adding hud components. It is fully documented here. If you need any help implementing libhud support for your mod, join my discord here.

Adds a customisable stack limit to the backpack slots in Traveler's Backpack .

By default, items in the backpack can be stacked in quantities of up to 256 per slot . 
This value was chosen to provide a moderate increase and can be adjusted via the configuration file. 
A more convenient in-game configuration using Modmenu is planned for future versions.

 Why choose this mod?
- More space : Larger stack sizes = more room in your backpack
- Targeted : No effect on normal Minecraft stack limits outside the backpack 
- Lightweight : Simple and designed for a single, clear purpose
- Efficient : Perfect for players who want to use their backpack more efficiently

 Features
- Increases the stack limit in backpack slots. Default: 256 
- Currently adjustable via the configuration file
- No known incompatibilities
- Only the backpack stack limit is changed

- As a mod developer , call the ItemDataAPI from your own mod to read/write values on items.

- Pluggable custom types via a simple CustomDataType interface.

Instant XP 1.0.0 (Fabric, Mincraft Java 1.21.11)
 

 
Instant XP removes the normal pickup delay and range limitations of experience orbs in Minecraft. Instead of waiting to walk near an orb, the XP is instantly transferred to the nearest player the moment the orb updates.

This makes experience collection smoother, faster, and far less annoying — especially when large numbers of orbs are created.

"Made the mod for personally use, in my single player world, not tested for multiplayer or servers but like to give the closest person to xp source the xp when killed in multiplayer"

What this mod does
When an experience orb exists in the world:

• The mod checks for the nearest player
• The orb's XP value is immediately given to that player
• The orb is removed instantly

This bypasses Minecraft’s normal pickup radius and attraction mechanics, so you no longer need to walk around collecting

basicallygraves:
This mod adds entity based graves
 unlike most grave mods that use blocks.

- the grave entity is about .5 blocks wide and 1 block tall (not completely accurate) 
- the grave entity is completely immune to any non-player caused damage, such as fire or cactus damage
- the grave entity has 1 health, meaning it can easily be killed with a simple punch
- the grave entity drops its items on death, with a small amount of random velocity (~1 block spread)

 
 pros: 
- Entity based graves are far less buggy and less likely to cause issues, as they dont need physical space to be created
- entity based graves can be moved around
- if a block based grave is crerated in the air, getting it can be problematic, an entity based grave however will simply fall to the ground

 cons: 
- im new to entities so currently the graves do not have an inventory menu, they simply drop the items on death

Scoreboard Health Indicators
 

 📋 Overview:
 
 🎮 Multiplayer 

- This mod works in both single-player and multiplayer.

- Important: Confirm that you are allowed to use this mod on the multiplayer server you are playing on, as it may be considered cheating.

 

 
 ❓ What It Does 

This mod displays the scoreboard-based health of players and entities as a health bar above them.

It works even if the server hides the internal health value or the entity is invisible.

 

 
 ❓ Why does it exist? 

Many servers hide real health values and instead display custom values using the scoreboard (for example below player names or in the player list).

These values can be harder to read, look cluttered, and disappear when players are too far away or invisible.

This mod solves that by converting the scoreboard value into a clean and consistent health bar.

This is an unofficial fork of Polymorph by IllusiveSoulworks, updated for Minecraft 1.21.10. 

Polymorph is a mod that solves recipe conflicts by letting players choose between all potential outputs shared by the same ingredients.

With a sufficiently large amount of mods, recipe conflicts are a common occurrence and the responsibility for resolving these usually falls on the user or modpack developer, using datapacks or other tools to ensure that each recipe is unique.

Polymorph offers an alternative solution, allowing all possible crafting and smelting recipes to co-exist regardless of conflicts.

 Fork Information

This fork updates Polymorph for Minecraft 1.21.10 (Fabric only).

 Changes from original:

- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.10 API
- Fixed smithing recipe handling for new recipe structure
- Removed NeoForge/Forge support (Fabric only)
- Various API compatibility fixes

 Origin

WorldEdit, however, preserved this system for its commands, but it only works for blocks added before 1.13. This mod reworks that system by linking it to the registry ID and also adds convenient ways to find out that ID.

 Disclaimer: The mod's functionality heavily differs depending on whether it is installed only on the client or on both sides 

 If installed only on client : Legacy IDs are used (only blocks added before 1.13 supported) 
 If installed on both sides or in singleplayer : Renewed registries-linked IDs are used (IDs may vary between different minecraft versions) 

 Why does this mod exist?

artvk:
ArtVK
ArtVK is an experimental Blaze3D backend implementation that uses Vulkan 1.0 with optional extensions.
 Goal
The main goal of this project is to bring the benefits of Vulkan (such as explicit synchronization and resource management, better render pipeline control) to older and less featureful graphics adapters.
 Current status
- Performance is close to the stock Vulkan backend on Intel Tiger Lake iGPU
- Compatible with Adreno 5xx+, Mali GPUs (PowerVR graphics have issues)
- Memory usage is higher compared to the stock Vulkan backend due to the game's frequent descriptor set updates
- Render distance is limited to 8 chunks because the descriptor set allocator is not mature enough
- Compatible with Sodium and Distant Horizons
 Contribute
Human-made code contributions are always welcome, however we are also looking for people with old (and mobile) devices, weird buggy drivers and such

Accuracy Tracker Mod
 Overview
Accuracy Tracker is a lightweight and strict accuracy tracking mod for Minecraft. It monitors how precisely you keep your crosshair on an entity, helping you refine your aim and improve performance in combat situations, providing accuracy in percentages.

 Features
 Strict Accuracy Tracking: Only records accuracy when the crosshair is directly on an entity's hitbox. 

 Dynamic HUD Display: Displays real-time accuracy at the top-middle of the screen. 

 Color-Coded Accuracy Meter: The HUD smoothly transitions from red (low accuracy) to blue (high accuracy) for easy visualization. 

 Customizable Reset Interval: Configure how long the tracker waits before resetting accuracy calculations. Open the menu through the default keybind "J"

To Hell With You
 One death is not the end… unless you're already in hell. 

 Overview
This mod overhauls Minecraft’s death mechanics to introduce a hardcore-inspired twist on survival. With To Hell With You , death is just the beginning—unless you're already in the Nether.

 Core Features
- Second Chance Mechanic: 
 If you die in the Overworld, instead of dying outright, you're cast into the fiery depths of the Nether. You’ll keep your items and have one goal: escape.

- Final Death in the Nether: 
 Once in the Nether, you're on borrowed time. A special status effect warns you that any further death here is permanent . In other words: if you die in the Nether, it's game over—items lost.

- Return and Redemption: 
 Survive the Nether and make it back to the Overworld? Congrats—you’ve earned a second chance. Your life continues, but death will once again banish you to hell.

 Why Use This

mc265520:
What does this mod do?

This is a fabric mod which fixes MC-265520 in Minecraft versions <1.20.5.

 What is MC-265520 about?

MC-265520 is about a race condition when switching between protocol states. The protocol states get switched while decoding packets and Minecraft expects the old protocol state when handling the switching packet on the main thread.

 How does this mod solve the issue?

This mod moves the FlowControlHandler added because of MC-265209 in front of the handler which switches protocol states.
The mod also uses a custom FlowControlHandler (based on the old, MIT-licensed AutoReadHolderHandler of Velocity) instead of changing how the entire networking pipeline works (as Mojang did in 1.20.5).

这个模组有什么用？ 这是一个修正了MC-265520在Minecraft版本<1.20.5中的结构模组。 MC-265520是关于什么的？ MC-265520是关于在协议状态之间切换时的竞态条件。协议状态在解码数据包时被切换，Minecraft在主线程上处理切换数据包时期望旧的协议状态。 这个模组是如何解决这个问题的？ 此模组将因MC-265209而添加的FlowControlHandler移动到切换协议状态的处理程序之前。 模组还使用了自定义的FlowControlHandler（基于旧的、MIT许可的Velocity的AutoReadHolderHandler），而不是改变整个网络管道的工作方式（如Mojang在1.20.5中所做的那样）。

 🧟 Overview

 Storyline Of Mineyarg introduces a real-time zombie apocalypse system into Minecraft.
Survive in a world where mobs evolve , snow spreads endlessly , and time itself is your enemy .
The apocalypse unfolds in real time , not in-game time — making every hour of gameplay meaningful.

 Apocalypse System

 Real-Time Progression — events depend on actual time
 Mob Evolution — hostile mobs become stronger and smarter
 Expanding Snowfall Zone — the cold slowly consumes the world
 Fully Configurable — adjust spawn rates, evolution speed, and snow growth

 Commands (Operator Only)

 
/apocalypse start – start the apocalypse 
/apocalypse stop – stop with progress loss 
/apocalypse pause – temporarily halt

Sophisticated Backpacks InventoryWeight

Accurate MT Inventory Weight support for Sophisticated Backpacks (Unofficial Fabric port) .

MT Inventory Weight ships a generic backpack calculator that reads container NBT, but Sophisticated Backpacks assigns each backpack a UUID and stores its real contents in world BackpackStorage (PersistentState) — not always in the item NBT. It registers an Inventory Weight item weight provider (via the inventoryweight entrypoint) at priority 8500 — above the built-in generic backpacks provider (8000) — so SB backpacks are handled by this accurate provider while everything else falls through to the defaults.

Simple Display Items
A simple datapack that allows you to disable interaction with an item, make it float, and make it immune to fire.

 Showcase
 

 (Watch on YouTube for better quality) 

 Usage
First run the following command:
 
/function sdi:craft/craft papers
 
This will give you two papers, one called "Display On" and one called "Display Off". 

To put an item in "display mode", throw the item on the block you want, then throw the "Display On" paper on top. If you see green particles, then it worked.

To take an item out of display mode, simply throw the "Display Off" paper at the item, and you can immediately pick it up.

 ❗WARNING❗
Items are not immune to explosions for now. This may change in the near future.

There is a built in crafting recipe that is disabled by default. To enable it, unzip the datapack and navigate to:

Description
Allows explosive Sulfur Cubes explode on contact with either blocks or entities. Power of explosion depends on cube's speed

 

 Technical stuff
Mod checks if blocks can explode in same way vanilla does for priming Sulfur Cubes. So anything that can be primed will explode on contact

Mod also comes with config (called explosive sulfur cubes.json in config folder) with following fields:
- explosionPowerMultiplier - controls power of explosion
- mixExplosionPower - minimum power of explosion
- maxExplosionPower - maximum power of explosion
- speedThreshold - minimal cube's speed required for explosion to trigger

The mod also changes how armor and damage is calculated, altering it from a linear to a logarithmic function.

 Once again, this is a modpack for a specific server, not a general modpack anyone can have fun with. If you do find this, and wish to give the server a shot, you can join our Discord Server to become one with the community and find the Server Address.

 As it is an English-Speaking server, there will be no translations for other languages.

ore-collapse:
Ore Collapse

Ore Collapse introduces geological instability to mining by making ore block breaks potentially trigger falling debris from the ceiling above.

 Mechanics

When a player mines any ore (iron, gold, copper, diamond, emerald, lapis, redstone, or coal), there is a chance that loose stone, gravel, or cobblestone blocks will detach from the cave ceiling directly above the mined area and fall as entities. The probability and severity scale with ore rarity—breaking diamond ore has a higher chance of triggering a significant collapse than breaking coal.

Falling blocks deal damage on impact. This creates genuine tension and risk assessment during mining expeditions.

 Risk Mitigation

Players can reduce risk by:
- Mining from angles that avoid collapse zones
- Placing torches or slabs as makeshift supports above them
- Wearing helmets for partial damage reduction
- Simply accepting

A resource pack for Minecraft Transit Railway. 

 Overview
The JR 209-0 Series are trains produced by Kawasaki, Tokyu Car Corporation, and JR Niitsu Rolling Stock Plant between 1992 and 1998. A total of 812 vehicles are produced for the Keihin–Tōhoku—Negishi Line and the Nambu Line, to replace the 103 series running on both lines. Scoruluce Small Smooth Swords (SSSS) is a resource pack designed to enhance the flat swords from the Faithful Classic 32x32 pack by offering smaller, more refined versions perfect for PvP and for players who prefer compact swords. SSSS swords feature a high level of detail with color gradients and intricate designs for each sword.

 

This pack is currently in beta, and while I've put a lot of effort into making it, there may still be some bugs. I rely on our community to help me improve the pack by reporting any issues and suggesting tweaks via my GitHub page.

 Features: 
- Enhanced, smaller sword textures based on the Faithful Classic 32x32 pack.
- Detailed textures.
- Small swords

 How to Contribute: 
Found a bug or have an idea for improvement? Please report it on my GitHub page. Your contributions help me make this pack better f

cc-mono:
CC: Mono

 

 

A few days ago, I noticed that the text in ComputerCraft's terminals is just the default Minecraft font. Now, this would be fine, if the Minecraft font was monospace. It isn't. The current solution? Just centre the characters. I don't like this solution because it makes the kerning look really off. So, I created something to fix it.

 Supports 1.17 to 1.20.6
抄送：单声道 几天前，我注意到ComputerCraft的终端中的文本只是默认的Minecraft字体。现在，如果Minecraft的字体是等宽字体，这就没问题了。但事实并非如此。目前的解决方案是？将字符居中。我不喜欢这种解决方案，因为它会让字距调整看起来很不合理。所以，我创建了一些东西来修复它。 支持1.17至1.20.6

inkboil: Most toon shaders do the same two things: posterise the light, add a black outline. That gives you a 3D game wearing a filter. Inkboil starts from how animation actually works — traditional animation runs at twelve frames a second, and that stepped cadence is most of what your eye reads as "hand-drawn". So the render stays perfectly fluid, and only the drawing steps: the tremble of the ink line, the phase of the hatching, the paper grain, the strokes running across the water. The part that makes it work is that it is never the position of the line that is cadenced, only the randomness of the gesture — so the line stays welded to the silhouette instead of lagging behind it. Unlike external bot tools like minecraft-stress-test that connect bots over the network, Better StressBots creates bots directly inside the server. Bots load chunks, trigger entity tracking and appear in the player list exactly like real players without needing offline mode. Walk mode makes bots snap to the terrain surface for more realistic civ and survival testing.

Make sure you have allow-flight=true in server.properties !

 Commands
 
/start Spawn bots with current settings
/start Spawn bots with a set amount
/start Spawn bots with a set mode
/start Spawn bots with a set amount and mode

/goto Send all bots to your location (player only)
/goto Send all bots to exact coordinates
/go

mcedia-tv-plugin:
McediaTVPlugin 是 Mcedia TV 的配套服务端插件。
它提供 McediaTV 所需的服务端频道同步系统、播放器管理流程以及游戏内控制界面。

McediaTVPlugin 不会将播放状态分别保存在每一个播放器实体上，而是将播放状态统一组织到 频道（channel） 中。
插件负责维护每个频道的媒体地址、播放状态、播放进度、播放速度和同步运行态，并向已订阅频道的客户端发布频道快照与同步更新。

这意味着同一个频道下的多个客户端可以围绕同一条播放时间线运行，而多个播放器也可以围绕同一个共享频道进行展示，而不是各自维护完全独立的播放状态。

 核心功能

 基于频道的同步播放
- 以 channel 为核心组织播放状态
- 在服务端维护频道的权威运行态
- 向已订阅客户端发布频道快照与同步更新
- 让同一频道下的多个客户端共享同一播放状态基准

 多客户端共享同一频道
- 一个频道可以同时被多个客户端观看
- 当频道状态发生变化时，已订阅客户端会收到新的同步数据
- 客户端在重连、恢复观看或重新建立订阅后，可以重新对齐到当前频道状态

 播放器管理
- 支持创建和管理 MTV 播放器
- 播放器可以与频道关联，用于共享展示内容
- 多个播放器可以围绕同一个频道工作
- 频道内容与播放器实体分离管理，便于统一控制播放状态

 播放控制与播放列表
- 支持媒体地址切换
- 支持播放、暂停、继续和同步控制
- 支持播放列表
- 支持多种播放顺序模式，包括顺序播放、随机播放和循环播放

 基于 GUI 的操作流程
- 提供 /mtv 入口
- 主要操作通过游戏内 GUI 完成
- 可在游戏内管理播放器、频道以及相关展示设置

 铁门遥控器
- 可将铁门重命名为 遥控器 并作为快捷控制道具使用
- 手持该物品时，可快速操作最近的 MTV 播放器
- 适合在不打开完整 GUI 的情况下进行就近控制
- 用于简化日常操作与现场控制流程

 公共频道
- 支持公共频道的创建、搜索和管理
- 可在服务器内将频道内容作为共享内容使用
- 不同玩家可根据服务端权限配置拥有不同

maxping:
Key Features:

Ping-Based Kicking: Automatically kicks players whose ping exceeds the configured limit (default: 50ms).

Configurable Settings: Adjust the maximum ping and kick message via config.yml.

Public Broadcasts: Optionally broadcast when a player is kicked for high ping, displaying their name, ping, and the server’s ping limit.

Bypass Permission: Players with the maxping.bypass permission (default: op-only) are exempt from ping checks.

Reload Command: Use /maxping reload (requires maxping.reload permission) to update settings without restarting the server.

Customizable Messages: Include placeholders ({maxPing} for kick messages, {player}, {playerPing}, {maxPing} for broadcasts) to provide detailed feedback.

Usage:
Set the maximum ping in config.yml (e.g., max-ping: 50).

Customize the kick message (e.g., You were kicked because your ping is too high! (Max: {maxPing}ms)).

ore-regeneration:
Ore Regeneration

As the name implies, this plugin aims to automatically regenerate ores! Don't worry, it works even if the server stops. (It simply regenerates all ores on server startup that were broken). 

 Config
It is really simple to configure what ores to regenerate! Simply go to the OreRegen folder in plugins, and open config.yml. Inside, just add to the list ores that you want! (There are example ores in there from newer version just for fun, this mod is only aimed at 1.12.)

To check the name of an ore, just keep open your server console, break a block, and it should output the name of the ore as broken to the console. For example a block called Ruby from a mod called Ruby Paradise (Fictional names, any similarities is purely coincidental), then it might be RP RUBY.
